newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends off on US dollar trend overseas.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends off on US dollar trend overseas.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly lower against its U.S. counterpart on Tuesday, reflecting the strength of the U.S. dollar overseas, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.489 against Monday's T$27.484 close. Turnover was a modest US$156 million.
But dealers noted persistent foreign fund inflows.
"Foreign equity funds continued to flow in, and this offset reaction to the U.S. dollar trend overseas," said one dealer.
Dealers said hopes for more foreign fund inflows would serve to curtail any slide by the local dollar despite the American currency's strength. -- James Peng (5080815)
